title: Mixed-Precision SEM-Based CFD Simulations on GPUs: A Taylor-Green Vortex case
abstract: arXiv:2608.24348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixed precision is a promising approach for reducing the computational cost and energy consumption of Computation Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, but its effectiveness depends strongly on where precision is reduced within the full simulation pipeline. In this work, we study Taylor-Green vortex case using Neko, a matrix-free CFD solver based on the spectral element method (SEM). Profiling shows that the fluid time step is not dominated by Krylov convergence alone: the velocity and pressure solvers require only a small number of iterations per step, while a substantial fraction of runtime is spent in other SEM operators and solver components. Motivated by this structure, we propose a three-level hierarchical mixed-precision control model. Two groups of configurations are evaluated in environments bounded by 64-bit floating-point (fp64) and 32-bit floating-point (fp32) precision, respectively. The fp64-bounded group identifies accuracy

translated_title: 基于GPU的混合精度SEM计算流体动力学模拟：泰勒-格林涡案例
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24348v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：混合精度是降低计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟计算成本和能耗的一种有前景的方法，但其有效性强烈依赖于在整个模拟流程中降低精度的位置。在本工作中，我们使用Neko（一种基于谱元法（SEM）的无矩阵CFD求解器）研究泰勒-格林涡案例。性能分析显示，流体时间步并非仅由Krylov收敛主导：速度和压力求解器每步只需少量迭代，而运行时间的很大一部分花费在其他SEM算子和求解器组件上。基于这种结构，我们提出了一种三级层次混合精度控制模型。在分别以64位浮点（fp64）和32位浮点（fp32）精度为界限的环境中评估了两组配置。fp64界限组识别了精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种三级层次混合精度控制模型，用于GPU上的SEM-CFD模拟，通过分析泰勒-格林涡案例的性能结构，在fp64和fp32精度界限下优化计算精度与效率的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-level hierarchical mixed-precision control model for SEM-based CFD simulations on GPUs, optimizing the balance between accuracy and efficiency by analyzing the performance structure of a Taylor-Green vortex case under fp64 and fp32 precision bounds.
